change.summary: Add exact priced purchase-only building supply and authoritative painting variants; prohibit permanent NPC goods and base Create in public market channels.

before.value: Public catalog only admitted reviewed two-way commodities; no unified permanent prohibition floor.

after.painting_variants: Server registry verified EntityTag.variant; aliases are offer IDs, not item registrations.
after.buyback: Existing two-way commodity rules only; no buyback for new BUY_ONLY stock.
after.create: Public supply/Buyer/shipping denied; suitable ordinary native merchant merchandise remains eligible.
after.localized_search: Packaged source-backed en_us/ru_ru item aliases and painting variant titles; no server-locale assumptions.

rationale.purpose: Add exact priced purchase-only building supply and authoritative painting variants; prohibit permanent NPC goods and base Create in public market channels.
rationale.decision_source: User Russian ability/market brief and approved chat plan, followed by do this all on 2026-10-16
rationale.user_requested: Prevent failed ability triggers and false cooldowns; remove narrator keyboard shortcut; expand building purchases with permanent NPC restrictions and public Create-only exclusion.
rationale.codex_choices: Exact budgets are conditional on shared categories and prohibition floor, not standalone item admission. Ore selectors exclude ore blocks, not ingots/gems. Native stock/restock, backed supply and payment/replay owners are retained. New supply limit is 256/account and4096/world units/day; acquisition tiers are authored independently by Codex with captured recipe ingredient floors. No new wire protocol.
